summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade when that option is offered, toward the 89 units the major needs (the Biological Chemistry path asks for more). The audit checks CHEM 100, the introductory chemistry, math and CS courses, and the foundational and advanced courses of the Traditional or the Biological Chemistry path you choose, with CHEM 131 as the WIM course and CHEM 185 as the capstone. Honors needs nine units of CHEM 190 research and nine letter-graded coursework units (six from the CHEM list, three more the Undergraduate Studies Committee approves, moved in by hand), none of them counted for another requirement, plus the GPAs and the thesis.
